pageFunction: async function pageFunction(context) { const {request,$} = context; const text = context.body ? context.body.toString('utf8') : $.root().text(); if(request.url.includes('/git/trees/')) { const obj = JSON.parse(text); return {url:request.url,loadedUrl:request.loadedUrl,sha:obj.sha,truncated:obj.truncated,tree:obj.tree.filter(x => /(^package.json$|^LICENSE|^README|example|model|store|menu|import|export|file|solar)/i.test(x.path))}; } return {url:request.url,loadedUrl:request.loadedUrl,body:text}; }
